about_short_description.short_description: DGI Apparel is a B2B marketplace where custom screenprinters can get all the resources they need to run their business.

product.name: Purchasing Platform
product.description: A tool that consolidates all vendor accounts into one platform, allowing users to see personalized pricing, promotions, and real-time inventory from multiple vendors.

product.name: Vendor Integration
product.description: Allows users to add their web accounts with major apparel vendors, supporting special and group pricing.

product.name: Price Comparison
product.description: Enables users to search all vendor catalogs simultaneously to find the best apparel items and compare prices and availability.

product.name: Cart Management
product.description: Allows users to manage all their carts on one page and checkout through their vendor's existing shipping and billing channels.
